summary: This line chart compares feedback questionnaire results between two groups: template-based and LLM-based approaches. It displays the distribution and mean scores of various questions answered on a Likert scale from 1 to 7. Key metrics include the effectiveness of questions in improving plans, reducing difficulty, and user confidence in goal selection. The LLM-based method significantly outperforms the template-based method in helping participants with their plans and reducing difficulty, as indicated by the varying mean scores and confidence intervals across the questions.
